_source: 2026-10-02 spike styling review (artifacts/spikes/2026-10-02-cc, docs/cc-subject-run §12); render order is the only YouCam control: the last layer sits on top. Ported 2026-10-16.

facts.length: top: cropped|waist|hip|tunic (Nova reads an owned top; unknown for catalog tops)

edit.why: YouCam's try-on has no tuck control and returns the same picture for the same input, so for some photos a tucked look always comes back untucked; re-encoded retries gave 0 tucked in 6 (2026-10-16, checked by eye). YouCam's own image editor tucks it from an instruction, on any photo, with no mask. Measured 2026-10-16: 5 of 5 tucked on the filmed photo (two outfits, one repeat gives different pixels but is still tucked); an already-tucked studio-model picture came back essentially unchanged; 1 unit each. The edit regenerates the picture, so face and garment detail can drift slightly.
edit.prompt: Tuck the top into the waistband of the {bottom} at the natural waist, so the waistband shows and the top drapes slightly over it. Change nothing else: same person, same face, same hair, same pose and hands, same top, same {bottom}, same shoes, same background and lighting.
edit.negative_prompt: different face, different person, changed clothing colour, extra fingers, distorted hands, blurry
